mandatory_disclaimer: Direct pore-water pressure validation data are currently unavailable. Modelled pore-water pressures and slope stability indicators represent theoretical limit-equilibrium approximations derived from physical principles (Terzaghi, Fredlund) and surface hydrometeorological observations, rather than direct in-situ piezometric measurements.
scientific_finding: On the tested controlled split, adding the physical features produced a small change in the reported metrics (delta ROC-AUC: +0.0002, delta Brier: -0.0003). This experiment does not establish independent generalization or causal benefit. Independent event-based validation is required.

data_availability_audit.slope_deg: DERIVED (Sobel / Evans 3D gradient filter from DEM)
data_availability_audit.profile_curvature: DERIVED (DEM second derivative along maximum gradient)
data_availability_audit.twi: DERIVED (Topographic Wetness Index ln(a / tan beta))
data_availability_audit.rainfall_1h_mm: REAL (IMD gridded rainfall & GPM IMERG 0.1 deg gauge-calibrated)
data_availability_audit.soil_moisture_pct: PROXY (Sentinel-2 NDMI / Copernicus SWIR band moisture proxy)
data_availability_audit.dist_to_river_m: REAL (HydroSHEDS / Copernicus derived river network vectors)
data_availability_audit.pore_pressure_est_kpa: MODELLED (1D limit equilibrium transient saturation mechanics)
data_availability_audit.delta_pore_pressure_kpa: MODELLED (Dynamic storm pressure increase above baseline)
data_availability_audit.effective_normal_stress_kpa: MODELLED (Terzaghi effective stress sigma' = sigma - u)
data_availability_audit.modelled_infinite_slope_fos: MODELLED (Infinite slope limit equilibrium Factor of Safety)
data_availability_audit.slope_stability_indicator: MODELLED (Normalized Relative Slope Stability Indicator FoS / (1 + FoS))
